SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN now() - "time" > interval '30 seconds' THEN
            'Нет данных'

        WHEN valid = false THEN
            COALESCE(measurement_error_text, validation_message, 'Ошибка датчика')

        ELSE
            ROUND(temperature::numeric, 1)::text || ' Вт/м²'
    END AS "sensor_01_text",

    CASE
        WHEN now() - "time" > interval '30 seconds' THEN -1
        WHEN valid = false THEN -1
        ELSE color_level
    END AS "sensor_01_color",

    COALESCE(sensor_name, 'Датчик 1') AS "sensor_01_Name",

    sensor_num AS "sensor_01_Number"

FROM public.sensor_measurements
WHERE
    $__timeFilter("time")
    AND sensor_used = true
    AND global_channel = 1
ORDER BY "time" DESC
LIMIT 1;
